profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Finch AI
profile.summary: Experienced Principal Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Go, Java, Javascript, Oracle Database, Scrum, Elasticsearch, and Linux. Strong engineering professional with a Master's degree focused in Information Technology from University of Maryland University College.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Engineer on a team managing three high-profile internal systems using Java, Hibernate, GWT and Gradle.  User support is provided on an ad-hoc basis while system administration is an on-going 24x7 effort.  Development for replacement of one system currently in the research stage with the intent of utilizing Elasticsearch and Golang in order to improve overall system performance.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as the ingest lead developing a custom pipeline for ingesting and parsing various data types. The pipeline has the capability to process individual files by  determining the data type, parsing the file into various entities, creating relationships, enriching the entities using geolocation, OCR and EXIF subprocesses and then loading into Elasticsearch.  Of note is the design and architecture of a config detection application that I solely developed.  The detection system gives the user the control of describing their data, thus giving the ingest pipeline the responsibility of making the proper determination on how the file is parsed.  The system was well received by the customer for its simplicity which added to the entire ingest process. Technologies utilized include Go, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Docker, Tika and Ubuntu.

Developed a standalone system that integrates COTSsoftware for image analysis and comparison. Software duties included developing a user interface for image management and notification,developing a C/C++ program for image analysis and developing a Go service wrapper for integrating and utilizing the external C/C++ program. Received an award for exceeding customer expectations on this effort. Technologies utilized include Go, CGO, C/C++, Javascript (jQuery, Bootstrap)and CentOS.

Developed a micro component for a large custom system that automates a post processing capability to enhance existing data. Development duties include creation of a user interface that allows batch processing of data through services written in Go as well as on-demand processing, logging and status results of processing. Technologies utilized include Go,Elasticsearch, Kibana, Javascript (jQuery, Bootstrap) and CentOS.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Rapidly developed custom Javascript UI components and ETL code for a real-time alerting and analytics platform. Also created, configured and managed Docker images for Elasticsearch and Kibana for development purposes as well as production deployment.  Implemented a microservice architecture for future development using Go-micro along with Docker. Technologies utilized include Go, Go-Micro, Docker, Elasticsearch, Kibana, X-Pack Security, Javascript (jQuery) Intellij IDEA, Eclipse, Git, Confluence and CentOS.

Developed custom Java processors for NiFi ETL data flows across multiple environments. Technologies utilized include Java, Apache NiFi, Intellij IDEA, Eclipse, Git, Maven, Jenkins CI, Confluence and CentOS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed a custom system for collecting, processing and enhancing data from multiple sources and then ingesting within a centralized repository for further analysis and query. Software development duties included analyzing data sources and developing parsing code, integrating custom software, incorporating complex data queries, developing and executing test procedures against software components, writing software and process documentation and ensuring quality control of all software through version control.  Database engineering duties included database design, development, and implementation for information storage and retrieval, database performance optimization, securing the Oracle database according to the Center for Information Security (CIS) security benchmark, applying Oracle critical patch updates, and designing and developing stored procedures and functions for data manipulation. Other duties included installing and configuring open source and COTS software, as well as identifying system bottlenecks and optimizations. Technologies utilized include Java, Groovy, Javascript (jQuery, Dojo), Elasticsearch, Apache Solr, Mule ESB, Oracle 11g, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Apache HTTP Server, Apache Tomcat, Eclipse IDE, Redmine, Git, Maven, Jenkins CI, Subversion, and CentOS Linux.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Team member in the development of a PKI-enabled, web-based software portal utilizing the Java Struts methodology that provided online collaboration, document sharing, event registration and section access control based on groups and/or certificate authentication. The portal was designed modularly and relied heavily on code reuse so the application could be quickly and easily deployed for multiple government clients. Modules could be added, removed, and configured to meet specific client needs eliminating the need to alter the code base.  Technologies utilized include Java, Apache Struts, Javascript, Apache HTTP Server, Apache Tomcat, NetBeans IDE and Linux.

Team Lead for a systems integration project that involved the planning and coordination of the activities of a diverse team of engineers in order to implement a PKI-enabled solution for remotely accessing client/server applications through a VPN. This solution also entailed the implementation of a more secure network design and the hardening of server operating systems.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Lead developer in the full lifecycle development of a web-based application for scheduling and managing meetings. The site provided a calendar interface for employees to schedule meetings associated with a specific project, including meeting agenda, and instant email notification to all selected attendees.  Additionally, employees could access the site during meetings to record meeting minutes and assign action items to specific participants. The site also provides several canned reports and was integrated with Microsoft Outlook. 

Team member in the development of an e-government site for the Xerox Citizen Service Center that provided online permit renewal, and civil fines and utility payment services. The site was made compliant in accordance with the W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines. Lead developer in the full lifecycle development of a web-based application, Shared Service Staffing System, for IRS managers and employees. This application was capable of capturing individual’s skills, managing allocation of resources to projects, and administering other aspects of management on any given project.  Full lifecycle development of a web-based application, Business Development Management System (BDMS) that was used for tracking and managing business development activities, opportunities, proposals, and task management. Developed, tested, and managed the deployment of the corporate web site
